candidates.description: This vector represents the concept of riding waves and boards in the sport of surfing.

This vector represents words, prefixes, or names starting with the letter sequence 'pe-' or containing the 'p' sound followed by a vowel.

This feature vector represents prefixes or morphological roots of words related to individuals, characters, or cultural terms.
